value.rationale: All-N comparison of the two smallest attainable values of the first sibling deficit, with equality iff uniform, is a natural local question left unresolved by expectation and transform extrema. The pairwise-square representation quantifies which sampling heterogeneities cause the strict bias. It is a structural finite-alphabet fact beyond the known uniform singleton table, with a meaningful higher-sibling boundary; no broad stochastic-order implication is asserted.
